Data volume 10 GB assumed because absent; egress 10000 GB/month assumed at 0.01 GB per year-12 user, minimum 1 GB; backup retention 1 months assumed.

Compute provisioning hypothesis: 50 RPS or 500 active users per reference allocation; WebSocket sidecars assume 250 connections/allocation. 301.25 vCPU/2-GiB-equivalent units include frontend/backend, auth, workers, inference and telemetry once. These are sizing assumptions requiring load tests, not capacity guarantees.

score_breakdown.reason: USD 6749.36–47771.68/month versus budget 0: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 1.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 2.75/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 1/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.
